TITLE: Base360
UNAVAILABLE: The Base360 connection is not switched on for this installation. Its operator can switch it on in the server configuration; until then nothing is sent to Base360.
ERROR: Base360 settings could not be loaded. Please try again.

CONNECTION.KEY_MATERIAL: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY (or a strong, unique JWT_SECRET) on the API before connecting: the connection key and the documents of the connection are stored encrypted with it.
CONNECTION.NOTICE: Connecting sends Base360: the product (Base360 Time Tracker) and its version, how it is installed, whether this API also serves team collaboration, the public part of a key this installation makes for the connection, the address of this web app so https://time.base360.ai can send you back here (https only; Base360 keeps only a fingerprint of it) and, if you choose, the ids of this organization and its tenant to link it at once. No address of this installation's API, no name and no e-mail address is sent. Paste the connect code you created in https://time.base360.ai.
CONNECTION.SECRET_SHORT: The secret that protects the keys of this connection (ENCRYPTION_KEY, or JWT_SECRET) is shorter than 32 characters. Use a long, random one.
CONNECTION.KEY_UNREADABLE: The connection key of this installation cannot be read since ENCRYPTION_KEY or JWT_SECRET changed, so nothing can be sent. Disconnect, then connect again with a new connect code.
CONNECTION.RETURN_UNUSABLE: The address of this web app (CLIENT_BASE_URL) is plain http outside this computer, so it is not sent: after a consent in https://time.base360.ai, come back to this page yourself.
CONNECTION.CONNECTED: Connected, linked to {{ handle }} on Base360
CONNECTION.REVOKED: Base360 revoked this installation's connection. Create a new connect code in https://time.base360.ai to connect again.

APPROVALS.TITLE: Approvals requested
APPROVALS.REQUESTED_BY: Approval requested by {{ handle }} on Base360
APPROVALS.ACCEPT_CONFIRM: Accepting starts moving, for the whole installation:
APPROVALS.DECLINE_CONFIRM: Declining withdraws the consent. Nothing is sent.

POLICY.TITLE: Instance policy
POLICY.DESCRIPTION: A denied integration is off for every organization of this installation, and no administrator can enable it.
POLICY.DENIED_BY_ENV: Denied by the server integration policy

DISCONNECT.TITLE: Disconnect
DISCONNECT.EFFECTS: Disconnecting stops every integration, removes the organization links and the entitlement documents, and stops the heartbeat and the event feed. Base360 is told when it can be reached. The anonymous usage statistics are not affected.

LINK.DESCRIPTION: Link this organization to a Base360 organization: paste a link code created in https://time.base360.ai. Base360 then knows the ids of this organization and its tenant, and the name of the product.
LINK.NOT_CONNECTED: This installation is not connected to Base360 yet.

INTEGRATIONS.DESCRIPTION: Nothing moves for an integration until an owner or administrator of the linked Base360 organization enables it in https://time.base360.ai. You can disable any integration here at any time; it stops at once, even when Base360 cannot be reached.
INTEGRATIONS.OPERATOR_ONLY: This integration acts for the whole installation: only its operator manages it.

ENTITLEMENTS.GRACE: Entitlements could not be refreshed since {{ date }}. Base360 features keep working during the grace period.
ENTITLEMENTS.PAUSED: Base360 features paused. Reconnect to Base360.

NOTICES.CONNECTED: This installation is connected to Base360.
NOTICES.PENDING: Connected, waiting for approval in https://time.base360.ai.
NOTICES.DISCONNECTED: This installation is disconnected from Base360.
NOTICES.CONSENT_OPENED: https://time.base360.ai opened in a new tab. Reopen this page afterwards to see the result.
NOTICES.DISABLED_OFFLINE: Disabled here. Base360 has not taken it yet; it is told again until it does.
NOTICES.ENTITLEMENT_UNCHANGED: This entitlement document (#{{ seq }}) is already the current one.

ERRORS.key_material_missing: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY (or a strong, unique JWT_SECRET) on the API first. Nothing was sent.
ERRORS.key_unreadable: The connection key cannot be read since ENCRYPTION_KEY or JWT_SECRET changed. Disconnect, then connect again with a new code.
ERRORS.consent_url_invalid: Base360 answered a link that cannot be opened. Nothing was opened.
ERRORS.redeem_unverifiable: Base360's answer could not be verified. The installation was not connected.
ERRORS.rotation_not_installed: The new key could not be installed. Try again.
ERRORS.code_invalid: This code is not valid. Create a new one in https://time.base360.ai.
ERRORS.product_mismatch: This code was created for another product.
ERRORS.not_connected: This installation is not connected to Base360.
ERRORS.denied_by_policy: The operator of this installation does not allow this integration.
ERRORS.not_available: This integration is not available yet.
ERRORS.keys_unverifiable: Base360's keys could not be verified for this address. Nothing was sent.
ERRORS.entitlement_unverifiable: Base360's entitlement document could not be verified. The installation was not connected.
ERRORS.platform_unreachable: Base360 could not be reached. Please try again later.
ERRORS.rate_limited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
ERRORS.entitlement_invalid: The entitlement document was refused: it does not name this installation, it is older than the current one, or it does not verify.
